topics.name: DWH Governed Remote
topics.purpose: Define governed remote DWH access as an explicit semantic/authorization path, including the rule that direct raw external dereference is not an alternate bypass path when AccessCore governance is active.

semantics.ac_on_rule: When AccessCore governance is active, direct raw $EXT dereference is disallowed as an authorization bypass; governed remote access uses the declared DWH remote path.
semantics.authority_rule: Remote authority is evaluated at the remote target according to remote policy and assurance/authorization rules.
semantics.local_owner_rule: Local ownership does not expand delegated remote rights.
semantics.read_only_rule: Remote surfaces remain read-only by default unless explicit remote write authority exists.
semantics.identity_rule: Origin identity remains the identity established at the origin; remote transport does not invent a new identity.
semantics.non_expansion_rule: Delegated remote access cannot silently expand rights beyond the explicitly delegated remote path.

invariants.rule: DWH local/remote, origin, schema, external identity, access path and transport-security semantics remain explicit and non-interchangeable.

hard_gates.condition: direct raw $EXT dereference bypasses governed remote path while AccessCore is active
local ownership grants broader remote rights automatically
remote write allowed without explicit remote write authority
transport session creates new trusted identity
delegated remote path expands rights beyond explicit delegation
remote authorization inferred from Topic membership or network reachability

references.purpose: Remote capability and remote authority remain separate.
